text.en: MOE CPDD. Science Teaching & Learning Syllabus, Primary Three to Six, 2023; updated Jan 2026. printed pp.67–70; PDF pp.68–71.
text.zh: MOE CPDD：《小学科学教学大纲：小三至小六，2023 版，2026 年 1 月更新》。

note.en: Read the existing local MOE PDF: printed pages 67–70, PDF pages 68–71. The remote entry presented robot verification and was not bypassed. Coral reefs apply the P6 Standard concepts; they are not a specifically named required habitat.
note.zh: 研究读取已存本地 MOE PDF：印刷页 67–70、PDF 页 68–71。远程入口有机器人验证，未绕过。珊瑚礁用于应用 P6 Standard 概念，不宣称是课纲点名必学的生境。

text.en: NParks. Coastal and marine ecosystems. Coral reefs section; dated 6 Aug 2026.
text.zh: NParks：《沿海与海洋生态系统》。

note.en: Coral reefs section, dated 6 August 2026. More than 250 hard-coral species describes Singapore waters, not one island. Direct text verified 29 October 2026.
note.zh: 珊瑚礁一节，日期为 2026 年 8 月 6 日；超过 250 种硬珊瑚指本地海域，不指一座岛。2026 年 10 月 29 日直接核对正文。

text.en: NParks BiodiversitySG. Hard Coral. About Hard Corals; updated 31 May 2026.
text.zh: NParks BiodiversitySG：《硬珊瑚》。

note.en: Anatomy reference only. The page’s Coral Triangle claim is not adopted. No photograph or diagram from the page is copied.
note.zh: 仅参照解剖事实，不采用该页的珊瑚三角区归属说法，不复制网页照片或图解。

text.en: NUS Reef Ecology Lab. Coral Reefs of Singapore. What is a coral reef; History; Blueprint.
text.zh: NUS Reef Ecology Lab：《新加坡珊瑚礁》。

note.en: Read What is a coral reef, History and Blueprint directly on 29 October 2026. General reef zones are not legal or universal depth boundaries. Reef extent and live-coral cover are different measures; no single loss percentage is used.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 29 日直接读珊瑚礁定义、历史及剖面。一般礁区不是法定或统一的深度界线；礁区面积与活珊瑚覆盖率口径不同，不采用单一损失百分比。

text.en: NOAA Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary. Coral Basics. Coral polyps; Coral Skeletons.
text.zh: NOAA Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary：《珊瑚基础》。

note.en: Anatomy and sixfold organisation; no nutrient-share percentage is used. The drawing’s twelve tentacles are a design example, not the count of every hard coral. Direct text read.
note.zh: 参照身体结构与六倍数排列，不采用食物贡献比例。图中十二根触手是设计示例，并非每种硬珊瑚的统一数量；已直接读正文。

text.en: NOAA National Ocean Service. Polyps up close. body, mouth, calyx and coenosarc; figure credit NOAA.
text.zh: NOAA National Ocean Service：《珊瑚虫近观》。

note.en: Central mouth, tentacles, supporting cup and connecting tissue. Direct text read; no NOAA diagram copied.
note.zh: 参照中央的口、触手、支撑杯及相连组织；已直接读正文，没有复制 NOAA 图解。

text.en: NOAA National Ocean Service. What is Zooxanthellae?. mutualistic relationship and bleaching.
text.zh: NOAA National Ocean Service：《虫黄藻与珊瑚的关系》。

note.en: Photosynthetic products are transferred from partners; this is not predation on the partners. The general clear-water account is qualified using Singapore field evidence in S10–S11. No fixed nutrient-share percentage is adopted. Direct text read.
note.zh: 伙伴转移光合产物，不是被珊瑚吞食。一般清水描述需结合 S10–S11 的新加坡实地证据理解，不采用固定食物贡献比例；已直接读正文。

text.en: NOAA National Ocean Service. What is coral bleaching?. survival and infographic transcript.
text.zh: NOAA National Ocean Service：《珊瑚白化》。

note.en: Bleaching can retain living tissue; recovery is conditional, not assured. Heat is a leading driver, with other stresses also described. Direct text read; no infographic copied.
note.zh: 白化仍可有活组织，恢复有条件而非保证。热是主要诱因之一，亦有其他压力；已直接读正文，不复制信息图。

text.en: NUS Reef Ecology Lab. Threats. sedimentation, bleaching, oil.
text.zh: NUS Reef Ecology Lab：《珊瑚礁面临的压力》。

note.en: Sedimentation, climate change and oil sections read directly. The page combines older depth descriptions near 10 m and newer growth shallower than 8 m; do not merge them into a universal threshold. Events in 1998, 2010 and 2016 are historical examples, not an exhaustive or current status list.
note.zh: 直接读沉积、气候变化及油污各节。页面有较早约 10 m 与较新浅于 8 m 的描述，不合并为统一界线；1998、2010、2016 年只作历史事件示例，不代表完整清单或当前状况。

text.en: Morgan, Moynihan, Sanwlani & Switzer; Frontiers in Marine Science (2020). Light Limitation and Depth-Variable Sedimentation Drives Vertical Reef Compression on Turbid Coral Reefs. Abstract; Introduction; copyright.
text.zh: Morgan, Moynihan, Sanwlani & Switzer; Frontiers in Marine Science (2020)：《光限制与不同深度沉积使浑水珊瑚礁垂直压缩》。

note.en: 2020 primary field study at Kusu and Pulau Hantu: crest sampling 2–3 m, slope sampling 7 m; the abstract summarises an euphotic depth of less than 11 m, while detailed results show daily and site variation. Not a universal boundary or a current reef census. Its measured attenuation coefficients are not used in the teaching calculation. Direct article text read.
note.zh: 2020 年龟屿与韩都岛实地研究，礁脊采样深度 2–3 m、礁坡 7 m；透光层不足 11 m。不是当前礁区普查，教学计算不使用论文实测衰减系数；已直接读原文。

text.en: NUS News. Resilience of Singapore corals. 1 July 2019; paragraphs on two study reefs.
text.zh: NUS News：《新加坡珊瑚的韧性》。

note.en: NUS report of 1 July 2019 concerns Pulau Hantu and Raffles Lighthouse and conditional resilience. Its typical 8 m description is not a universal survival limit. Direct text read.
note.zh: 2019 年 7 月 1 日国大报道涉及韩都岛与莱佛士灯塔及有条件的韧性；常见 8 m 描述并非统一存活极限。已直接读正文。

text.en: NParks. Sisters’ Islands Marine Park. Location; Park size; Dos and don’ts; Coral reefs.
text.zh: NParks：《姐妹岛海洋生态园》。

note.en: Location, 40 ha park size and no-collecting rule directly verified. The park comprises Sisters’ Islands and western reefs of St John’s Island and Pulau Tekukor; Pulau Hantu is separate. No changing visitor schedules are included.
note.zh: 直接核对范围、40 ha 面积及禁止采集要求；园区含姐妹岛、圣约翰岛与 Pulau Tekukor 西侧礁，韩都岛另属地点。不加入可能变动的参观时间。

text.en: NParks. Coral nursery at Small Sister’s Island. nursery purpose and reef substrate.
text.zh: NParks：《小姐妹岛珊瑚苗圃》。

note.en: The local nursery off Small Sister’s Island is a purpose-built reef structure. The model frame is a generic teaching device, not its measured engineering design. Direct text read.
note.zh: 小姐妹岛外苗圃采用专门建设的礁体结构。模型支架是通用教学工具，不是该工程的实测复刻；已直接读正文。

text.en: NParks. 100k Corals Initiative launch. release body dated 10 December 2024.
text.zh: NParks：《100k 珊瑚计划启动新闻稿》。

note.en: Use the explicit body date, 10 December 2024; the CMS header says 3 October 2024. Planting 100,000 corals over ten years and beyond is a goal, not an achieved total or survival rate. Direct text read.
note.zh: 采用正文明确日期 2024 年 12 月 10 日；CMS 页头另显示 10 月 3 日。十年及更长时期种植十万株是目标，不是已完成数量或成活率；已直接读正文。

text.en: NParks. Transforming Singapore into a City in Nature; Annual and Sustainability Report 2025/2026. Stepping Up Efforts in Species Recovery.
text.zh: NParks：《2025/2026 年报：将新加坡转变为大自然里的城市》。

note.en: 2025/2026 annual-report section Stepping Up Efforts in Species Recovery. It reports the facility opening on 7 April 2025 and first transplantation. This is reported work, not survival monitoring or completion of the planting goal. Direct report read.
note.zh: 2025/2026 年报的物种恢复段报告设施于 2025 年 4 月 7 日开放及首次移植。这是开展工作的报告，不是成活监测，也不等于完成种植目标；已直接读报告。

text.en: NUS Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum. Cnidaria. collection and conservation inventory.
text.zh: NUS Lee Kong Chian Natural History Museum：《刺胞动物馆藏》。

note.en: Museum collection supports inventories and conservation assessment; approximately 3,000 stony-coral specimens are collection holdings, not organisms counted in the sea. Direct text verified.
note.zh: 馆藏用于名录与保护评估；约三千件石珊瑚标本属于馆藏，不是海中生物数量。已直接核对正文。

text.en: NParks. Recognising Eight Marine Creatures. Peckish Parrots; 3 February 2025.
text.zh: NParks：《认识八种海洋动物》。

note.en: Peckish Parrots section, 3 February 2025: beak-like jaws and surface grazing. The model uses a functional group, without claiming a particular fish species. Direct text read.
note.zh: 2025 年 2 月 3 日鹦嘴鱼段：喙状颌与礁面摄食。模型采用功能组，不声称特定鱼种；已直接读正文。

text.en: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries. Coral Reef Ecosystem Organisms table. PDF pp.1–2; phytoplankton, zooplankton, coral and zooxanthellae rows.
text.zh: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries：《珊瑚礁生态系统生物关系表》。

note.en: PDF pages 1–2. General reef feeding examples, including phytoplankton, zooplankton and coral food sources. These are not observations of the four links on a Singapore reef. Direct PDF text read.
note.zh: PDF 第 1–2 页，一般礁区摄食示例，包括浮游植物、浮游动物及珊瑚食物来源；不冒称本图四条关系在新加坡礁上的实测。已直接读 PDF 文本。

text.en: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries. Modeling Coral Reef Ecosystems: Rainforests of the Sea. PDF pp.2–3; food webs and producers.
text.zh: NOAA Office of National Marine Sanctuaries：《珊瑚礁生态系统建模教学计划》。

note.en: PDF pages 2–3 for food-to-consumer arrows and producer roles. The graph is an original selection and is not a reproduction of the full American Samoa community. Direct PDF text read.
note.zh: PDF 第 2–3 页支持食物指向消费者的箭头及生产者角色。图是原创选取，不复刻美属萨摩亚的完整群落；已直接读 PDF 文本。

text.en: Sustainability (2020), 12(11), 4676. Socio-Ecological Controversies in the News as Trigger of a Model-Based Inquiry Instructional Sequence about the Effect of Global Warming on the Great Barrier Reef. §4.1 participants; §5.1 students’ conceptions.
text.zh: Sustainability (2020), 12(11), 4676：《新闻中的社会生态争议与全球变暖模型探究教学》。

note.en: Preparation access received HTTP 429; no bypass attempted. Preparation’s visible record describes 47 Spanish pupils aged 13–14. Used only to inform question design, never as evidence for the prevalence of a misconception among Singapore primary pupils.
note.zh: 准备期直接访问返回 HTTP 429，未绕过。可见研究记录涉及西班牙 47 名 13–14 岁学生，仅启发提问设计，不代表新加坡小学生的误解频率。

text.en: NUS Reef Ecology Lab. Hard Corals gallery. boulder, sheet and young staghorn photographs.
text.zh: NUS Reef Ecology Lab：《硬珊瑚图库》。

note.en: Local photographs establish examples of boulder and sheet forms. Reference only; no photograph copied and no model species inferred from shape alone.
note.zh: 本地照片供圆丘和片状形态参照，不复制照片，不单凭模型形态鉴定物种。

text.en: NOAA National Ocean Service. Can I use your image or graphic?. public domain and third-party exceptions.
text.zh: NOAA National Ocean Service：《NOAA 图片使用说明》。

note.en: Asset licence review only; NOAA public-domain policy has third-party exceptions. No source image from this page is redistributed.
note.zh: 仅用于素材许可核查；NOAA 公有领域政策有第三方例外。本题不转发该页图片。

text.en: NOAA Coral Reef Watch. CRW Disclaimer and Recommendations for Citing Data and Products. public domain; recommended credit.
text.zh: NOAA Coral Reef Watch：《珊瑚礁监测资料引用及免责声明》。

note.en: Candidate-data licence review only. No Coral Reef Watch data, temperature threshold or live request is included.
note.zh: 仅用于候选数据许可核查，不加入珊瑚礁监测数据、温度阈值或实时请求。

text.en: Allen Coral Atlas Partnership / Arizona State University. Allen Coral Atlas resources and FAQ. General citation; Satellite Imagery; Other Data.
text.zh: Allen Coral Atlas Partnership / Arizona State University：《Allen Coral Atlas 资源与常见问题》。

note.en: Candidate-data review only; satellite imagery and other data have different terms. No Allen Coral Atlas data is shipped and no terms workflow executed.
note.zh: 仅审查候选数据；卫星影像与其他数据条款不同。本题不随附该地图集数据，也不执行条款同意流程。

text.en: Allen Coral Atlas. Allen Coral Atlas Data Download Directions. steps 8–9: agreement and emailed package.
text.zh: Allen Coral Atlas：《Allen Coral Atlas 数据下载说明》。

note.en: Download-agreement workflow documented only; no acceptance, download or derivative file.
note.zh: 仅记录下载需同意条款的流程；未同意、下载或制作衍生文件。

text.en: US National Park Service / Caroline Rogers. What is a Coral?. colonies; larvae; feeding and bleaching.
text.zh: US National Park Service / Caroline Rogers：《珊瑚是什么》。

note.en: General coral colony, larvae and feeding background. Caribbean examples are not presented as Singapore species. Direct text read.
note.zh: 参照一般珊瑚群体、幼体及摄食背景，不将加勒比海例子写成本地物种；已直接读正文。

text.en: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution. Why do corals bleach?. loss of zooxanthellae and/or coloration.
text.zh: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution：《珊瑚为何白化》。

note.en: Bleaching can involve loss of algae and/or their pigments. The teaching states compare evidence rather than an assured sequence. Direct text read; copyrighted photographs not copied.
note.zh: 白化可涉及失去藻类或其色素；教学状态比较证据，不代表必然顺序。已直接读正文，没有复制受版权保护的照片。

text.en: Atlas original coral-reef design study. A schematic 3 m habitat and enlarged specimens; six food-web nodes, four selected general relationships. Five controls: removal, inspected consumer, illustrative depth, water case and independent tissue-evidence state. The static model has 37 rows and 20 outputs.
text.zh: Atlas 珊瑚礁原创设计研究：3 m 宽的示意生境与放大标本；六节点、四条一般食物关系；五控件分别为移走节点、查看消费者、示意深度、水体情况及独立组织证据。静态模型有 37 行、20 个输出。

note.en: Not field measurements, population forecasts or survival thresholds. Present = nodes except removal; support follows the selected directed acyclic paths from remaining producers; active inputs count supported incoming edges. Light L = 100 exp(−kz), z = 1, 3 or 7 m and design k = 0.1 or 0.5 per metre. Evidence states partnered/bleached-alive/dead-skeleton independently set living-tissue presence 1/1/0 and partner display 1/0/0. All 378 control combinations are deterministic and isolated. Twelve tentacles and animation speeds are schematic. Sources S5–S8, S10, S17–S19, S26–S27 constrain the biological explanation, not these original numerical design choices.
note.zh: 不是实地测量、种群预测或存活阈值。未移走节点由全部节点减去移走项；从剩余生产者沿选入有向无环路径判定支持；有效输入计支持的入边。光指数 L = 100 exp(−kz)，z 取 1、3、7 m，设计 k 取每米 0.1 或 0.5。有伙伴／白化仍活／死骨骼三个独立状态的活组织为 1／1／0，伙伴显示为 1／0／0。378 个组合确定且互不污染。十二触手与运动速率均为示意。S5–S8、S10、S17–S19、S26–S27 约束生物解释，不为这些原创设计数值提供实测背书。
